serverInfo.name: datarust
serverInfo.description: Scikit-learn-style preprocessing, classical machine learning, and data profiling in Rust

tools.name: profile_dataset
tools.description: Profiles tabular data from CSV content, generating descriptive statistics, distribution metrics, pairwise correlations, and data quality checks.

csv_data.description: The CSV content to profile (including header row)

target_column.description: Optional name of the target column for leakage detection and associations

tools.name: train_linear_regression

tools.name: evaluate_metrics
tools.description: Computes regression metrics (R2, MSE, RMSE, MAE) or classification metrics (accuracy).
